name: longwave
description: Longwave is the video pipeline an agent plugs into. Point it at a long-form episode, podcast or YouTube video and one recording becomes a whole distribution stack: captioned vertical Shorts and clips, contextual AI thumbnails generated from the transcript, and transcript-based titles, descriptions, chapters, show notes and per-platform post copy. It builds and syndicates a podcast RSS feed to 13 directories, publishes an X post plus an X video supercut, and ships a public link-in-bio hub. YouTube and X publish automatically; every other clip is a captioned vertical file ready for Reels, TikTok and LinkedIn. One MCP connection — OAuth 2.1, 15 tools, no API key pasted, no video downloads, no YouTube Studio. Built by Signal Group Limited (New Zealand) — longwave.media.
